answer.text: Open = subscribe/redeem anytime at NAV; Close-ended has fixed tenure + listing

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Open-end = liquid daily at NAV; Close-end = tradable on exchange till maturity. **The Trap:** ETF hybrid model exists. **Cross-Exam Context:** V-A. **Manager's Pro-Tip:** Open-end offers liquidity but may dilute returns during mass redemption; close-end locks capital.
